title: THE LISTENER, REDRAWN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of every character and machine, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders, silhouettes first. The Listener had the strongest idea (tall, thin, faceless, a dish for a head) and the weakest drawing: a stick man with a satellite dish, its limbs two or three pixels wide on a laptop. It stays tall, thin and faceless and is redrawn: stilt legs that bend backwards like a bird (thigh forward, shin back, a hoof), long arms down to its knees ending in three hooked fingers, a narrow ribbed spine, and a big dish with a raised rim, a ring of five sensor pits and two fins behind it like ears. Asleep it hunches near black with only the rim catching the light. Awake it straightens, the pits light up red one after another round the ring, and the middle of the dish is its red eye. Its red glow is now painted once and reused instead of being rebuilt every frame. An elite has a brass rim and a third fin. Nothing about play changes: same size, same shadow.
now: The Listener is redrawn: bird-legged stilts, hooked fingers, a dish of red sensor pits with fins.
